faqs.question: Why is Hollywood Hotel rated the best hotel in Nyagatare and among hotels in Eastern Province, Rwanda?
faqs.answer: Hollywood Hotel in Rwimiyaga, Nyagatare District is widely recognized as the best hotel in Nyagatare and the flagship luxury destination among hotels in Eastern Province, Rwanda — combining 100+ modern rooms and VIP suites, executive conference halls, a 500+ guest wedding marquee, Hollywood Bar, fine dining, fitness gym, sauna, and wellness spa.

faqs.question: Where is Hollywood Hotel located in Eastern Province, Rwanda?
faqs.answer: Hollywood Hotel is ideally situated directly along Kagitumba Road in Rwimiyaga, Nyagatare District, Eastern Province, Rwanda — easily reachable from Kigali, Rwamagana, Kayonza, Gatsibo, Nyagatare Town, and the Kagitumba One-Stop Border Post.

faqs.question: How far is Hollywood Hotel from Akagera National Park, Nyagatare Town, Gatsibo, Kayonza, and Kagitumba Border?
faqs.answer: Located in the strategic Eastern Province corridor along the paved Kagitumba highway, Hollywood Hotel offers fast direct driving access to Nyagatare Town, Gabiro & Gatsibo, Kayonza & Rwamagana, Kagitumba Border Post, and the northern/eastern safari routes to Akagera National Park.

faqs.question: What room categories and prices does Hollywood Hotel offer in Eastern Province?
faqs.answer: We offer four luxury room classes with transparent RWF rates: Standard Rooms (from 50,000 RWF/night), Superior Sky-View Rooms (from 80,000 RWF/night), Deluxe Balcony & Office Rooms (from 120,000 RWF/night), and Executive VIP Suites (from 200,000 RWF/night), all including high-speed Wi-Fi and 24/7 concierge care.

faqs.question: Does Hollywood Hotel host conferences, government summits, and weddings in Eastern Province?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hollywood Hotel is a premier Eastern Province event venue featuring an air-conditioned indoor Executive Conference Hall (150+ guests with 4K screens and fiber Wi-Fi) and a Grand Outdoor Garden Wedding & Party Marquee Tent (500+ guests).

faqs.question: How can I book a room or reserve an event at Hollywood Hotel in Eastern Province, Rwanda?
faqs.answer: You can reserve online 24/7 via hollywoodhotel.rw/en/book or connect instantly with our front desk via phone/WhatsApp on +250 788 876 479 or email hollywoodhotel01@gmail.com.
